---
name: Accessibility Barrier
about: Report an Accessibility Barrier
title: "[ACCESSIBILITY]"
labels: accessibility, documentation
assignees: ''
type: Bug

---

**Describe the accessibility barrier**
A clear and concise description of the accessibility issue (e.g., Screen reader does not announce button X, insufficient color contrast, keyboard focus trap).

**Device & Assistive Technology**
- **Device:** [e.g. iPhone 14, Samsung Galaxy S23, Desktop]
- **OS / Version:** [e.g. iOS 17.2, Android 14, Windows 11]
- **Assistive Technology:** [e.g. VoiceOver, TalkBack, Switch Access, Zoom, Keyboard only]
- **Flutter App Version:** [e.g. 1.2.0]

**Steps to Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the barrier:
1. Open the app and navigate to '...'
2. Enable [e.g. VoiceOver / TalkBack / High Contrast Mode]
3. Navigate to '....'
4. Observe the issue (e.g. '....')

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of how the app should behave to be accessible (e.g. Screen reader should announce label and state clearly).

**Relevant WCAG Criteria (optional)**
- [e.g. 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)]
- [e.g. 2.1.1 Keyboard]
- [e.g. 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value]

**Screenshots / Screen Recordings**
If applicable, add screenshots or audio/video recordings to help explain the issue.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or Flutter details about the problem here (e.g. specific Flutter widget involved, missing `Semantics` widget, etc.).
